decision: record is a fixed form (record <call> <action> because <reason>, then assert lines), parsed without a model
why: a person's call must be what they typed; no model turns prose into a fact

decision: assertions limited to the predicate table's assertable set, validated by the engine before anything is kept
why: a call cannot assert a derived count or an arbitrary fact

decision: the permalink comes from Slack's chat.getPermalink for the thread root, through signed events only, never from the message text; without it nothing is recorded
why: provenance must be where the call was made, as Slack states it
evidence: slack-events.test.ts: asked Slack for channel/thread; no link, nothing recorded

decision: the engine keeps only a Slack thread permalink (https://<workspace>.slack.com/archives/<channel>/p<16 digits>) as provenance, checked at the port and in the engine
why: a link shown to readers must not be an arbitrary URL

decision: the permalink rides on the call's memory entry and on the memory record its facts become; answer sources carry it as link; the card shows it as a plain URL
why: the next answer cites the thread the call came from
evidence: criteria P4.1; slack-events.test.ts: next card cites the link
